thesis: The page is the repointing sequence: every section is a course of work, and the mortar joint between them advances from raked-out gap to finished concave profile as you scroll.

signature.name: Mortar Joint Progression
signature.summary: Horizontal divider drawn as two brick courses with a mortar gap whose profile advances through repointing stages (raked → packed → struck → tooled → concave); animates via --sw-p; data-sw-signature hook.

palette.family: Lime Cream + Soft Brick + Iron Ink

motion.intro: Hero frame unclips from raked-joint line outward; headline lines rise with 70ms stagger; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Pinned joint cross-section advances through rake/pack/strike/tool stages on scroll (≥640px); stacked cards below.
Concave joint draws left-to-right via --sw-p in guarantee band.
motion.hover: Hairline scaleX(0→1) from left origin, 200ms, @media (hover:hover) only.
